method: points: insert {_id, loc: Point [lng, lat]} into a collection with {loc: "2dsphere", _id: 1}, read every key with returnKey (stored as an unsigned 64-bit id) (4 000 random points on the sphere, 3 500 within 1e-9 degrees of the meridians at multiples of 45, 2 000 within 1e-7 degrees of the latitude of the cube corners, 45 at multiples of 45 degrees, 2 exact ties between x and y); boundaries: u = tan(lng) where the level-5 cell changes along the equator of face 0, by bisection to 60 steps
note: first measured on 7.0.45; re-measured on 9.0.4 with the same leaves and boundaries
